speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with hand tremors and recent memory issues; can you tell me when you first noticed these symptoms and if they are getting worse over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your 70-year-old male profile with a one-year history of progressive left-sided resting tremor and recent cognitive decline in financial management, have you noticed any stiffness, shuffling gait, or a feeling of slowness in your movements?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of a resting tremor, soft speech (hypophonia), reduced facial expressions (masked facies), and apathy/financial difficulties strongly points to Parkinson's disease. Have you noticed any issues with balance, frequent falls, or a change in your handwriting?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease
